safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder. Generated mentions mild shoulder pain with movement (section-004) but does not state shoulder tingling/numbness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness can mislocalize the neurologic process (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus vs distal entrapment), potentially altering diagnostic workup and urgency. In this case the overall concern for neurologic pathology is still captured, so the main impact is reduced clinical clarity.
